Each hard traditional theorem is tracked by 4-state status AND a richer ledger: bridge_level L0-L5 (L0 classifier-equality, L1 encode/decode round-trip, L2 algebra/order preservation, L3 quotient/setoid equiv, L4 mathlib-structure equiv, L5 theorem-transfer both ways), external_endpoint, axiom_profile, and counts_toward_real_maturity. The dashboard MUST NOT aggregate stdEquivChecked into one number — report per-object/per-level. transferred_to_std is 0 by the mathlib-free Core invariant; reaching it needs the operator-scope axiom-firewalled BEDC.StdBridge layer (see project_stdbridge_path_to_traditional_equiv).
